item.text: {"ranked_proposal_ids":["weight-fp8"],"reason":"Use the remaining trial to test deployment feasibility: weight-fp8 has an estimated peak of 90,248,921,088 bytes, leaving 2,128,841,932 bytes within the service budget. FP8 linear weights save memory at potential precision cost while other specified weights and KV remain BF16. The trial can verify loading, workspace needs, actual peak memory, and quality against the 0.99 floor; none are established by these estimates. The BF16 baseline cannot fit, so baseline speedup and the required 5% latency improvement cannot be measured. This recommendation does not approve quality or performance gates."}
